tagline: Your trusted companion for PCOS awareness & daily support
landing_hero_line1: Your body has been telling you something.
landing_hero_body: Irregular cycles, sudden acne, hair changes, tiredness that no one takes seriously — these can be signs of PCOS. Sakhi helps you notice the pattern, in your language, at your pace, without anyone else knowing.
landing_cta_footnote: Takes about 2 minutes · No report is shared with anyone · Free
landing_stat_1_in_5_body: young Indian women live with PCOS — and most of them have never been diagnosed.
landing_what_body: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome is a common hormone and metabolism pattern. It is not a disease you caught, not your fault, and not something that ends your future. It is something you learn to work with.
landing_pcos_hormones_body: Ovulation gets delayed or skipped, so periods arrive late, heavy, or not at all for months.
landing_pcos_signs_body: Acne along the jaw, hair thinning on the head, extra hair on the face, weight that shifts easily.
landing_pcos_manageable_body: Food, sleep, movement and — when needed — simple medication. Most women feel better within months.
landing_video_subtitle: A short, calm explainer in Marathi and English — made for you, and for the aunt who says you just need to eat less rice.
landing_disclaimer: Sakhi is a screening and support tool. It does not diagnose PCOS or replace a doctor.

diet_subtitle: A weekly meal plan built around what's actually available in your kitchen — jowar, bajra, local greens.
diet_plan_info: This plan uses regional Maharashtrian staples — millets, leafy greens, dals, and curd. These are naturally PCOS-friendly: high fiber, low glycemic, and rich in the nutrients your body needs. Adjust portions to your appetite.
diet_plan_tip: Consistency matters more than perfection. Following this plan 5 out of 7 days is still a big win. On the other days, use the Family Plate tool below.
diet_plate_subtitle: Select the dishes your family is actually making. Sakhi will give you one small, practical tweak — not a whole new menu.
diet_disclaimer: Sakhi provides general nutritional guidance, not medical diet plans. Always consult a doctor or registered dietitian for personalized advice.

festival_disclaimer: These are general wellness tips for festival eating, not medical dietary restrictions. Celebrate with your family — food is love, and love is good for you.
